sections.label: abstract
sections.heading: Abstract
sections.text: We studied outcomes in older patients with heart failure.

sections.label: methods
sections.heading: Methods
sections.text: A retrospective cohort of 200 patients was analysed. Data came from a single national registry.

sections.label: results
sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Mortality was 12% over the follow-up period.

sections.label: limitations
sections.heading: Limitations
sections.text: The cohort was single-center and observational.
